svg.title: Copy on Windows. Paste on Mac.
svg.desc: An illustrated folder copy from Windows to Mac, using Ctrl + C to copy and Cmd + V to paste. Real Finder windows contain temporary sample files; native Explorer chrome has illustrated sample contents. Files usually transfer when pasted. The whole Project files folder arrives with Checklist.txt and Project brief.txt inside. The original v2.4.1 Clipboard sharing setting is shown enabled. Keep the source connected. Both computers need v2.4.1. This illustrates the flow and is not a recording or speed measurement.
svg.text: Copy on Windows. Paste on Mac.
Files and whole folders, with the shortcuts you already use.

g.text: Select it in Explorer, then press Ctrl + C.
Press Cmd + V in Finder. Files usually transfer when you paste.
“Project files” is now on both computers.
Open the received folder to see its files.

svg.text: Keep the source computer connected until pasting finishes. Update both computers.
Native Finder capture; Explorer with sample contents. Transfer timing is illustrated.
